correctness.rationale: For each K_{p,q}, p,q≥2, B incidence, V=B/2, Q=(pq/4)BBᵀ on H=1⊥. Its gauge of Vε is εᵀΠε/(pq), with Π the edge-row-space orthogonal projection, hence ≤1 on cube signs and entire zonotope by convexity. Equality iff sign matrix lies in row-space, equivalently all 2×2 alternating sums vanish. A ±1 matrix with this additively separable property must have either every row constant or every column constant, giving exactly 2^p+2^q−2 distinct contacts; injectivity of V on row-space excludes duplicates. Independently enumerated all sign cubes for (p,q)=(2,2),(2,3),(3,3) in exact SymPy rational arithmetic: 6,10,14 contacts and no other gauge-one signs. In the general proof, mixing near-balanced row/column sign patterns and both poles with explicit positive α,β,γ yields mean zero, covariance Q/d on the three Laplacian eigenspaces. Trace+AM–GM proves global minimum determinant/uniqueness against translated nonsymmetric ellipsoids. Nonzero Laplacian eigenvalues q,p,p+q yield stated intrinsic semiaxis and volume formulas. No arbitrary graph/weight claim.
